requirements.protection: Authenticated storage encryption, hardware-backed key protection where supported, integrity checking.
requirements.limitation: Tests cannot establish algorithm strength or side-channel resistance.
requirements.evidence_needed: Review platform-specific key protection, runtime integrity and independent security evidence.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Tests cannot establish algorithm strength or side-channel resistance.

requirements.protection: Encryption in transit and at rest, no plaintext logs/caches, isolated processing.
requirements.limitation: Platform-specific exposure vectors and deployment variation remain.
requirements.evidence_needed: Inspect logs, temporary files, processing isolation and actual runtime configurations.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Platform-specific exposure vectors and deployment variation remain.

requirements.limitation: Physical tampering and platform variation incompletely tested.
requirements.evidence_needed: Exercise tamper detection and response, compare hardware/software properties and recovery outcomes.
requirements.potential_harm: Tampering enables unauthorized use or lockout.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Physical tampering and platform variation incompletely tested.

requirements.limitation: Finite network/device combinations and regression exposure.
requirements.evidence_needed: Exercise disconnected devices, DNS/status/telemetry absence and compatible verification.
requirements.potential_harm: Offline access failure or stale-status acceptance.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Finite network/device combinations and regression exposure.

requirements.limitation: Covert OS/firmware exfiltration or later capability changes not excluded.
requirements.evidence_needed: Inspect recipient attribution, holder-only access, export/deletion and backups/telemetry; reconcile with audit obligations.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Covert OS/firmware exfiltration or later capability changes not excluded.

requirements.disposition_rationale: UI usability and all combinations not established.

requirements.protection: Explicit bounded requests matching RP purpose; no wildcard or incidental processing.
requirements.limitation: Request matching does not establish necessity of stated purpose.

requirements.disposition_rationale: Request matching does not establish necessity of stated purpose.

requirements.disposition_rationale: Notice comprehension and real necessity not established by automated gate tests.

cases.constructed: Wallet displays and captures consent for a bounded request, but recipient or purpose changes before verifier/RP processing; each component has a locally satisfied gate.
cases.evidence: Bind actual purpose, recipient, requested and selected attributes to authorization and consent; test mismatched context, replay, missing conditions, early processing and fallback across actors. No claim that source mandates a specific binding protocol.

cases.constructed: Holder-only log works locally, but provider backup or diagnostic integration exposes presentation history.
cases.evidence: Inspect holder-only access, export, irreversible deletion, backups, SDKs and audit evidence boundaries; distinguish user-controlled history from program audit.

cases.constructed: Verifier clears transaction cache, but downstream RP logs plaintext attributes or retains them for a different purpose.
cases.evidence: Trace end-to-end copies and purposes; assess each actor's distinct obligations, plaintext logging limitation and secondary processing authority. Do not impose verifier wording on RP without source interpretation.

cases.constructed: Qualifying health provider invokes general permissive RP acceptance to reject SEDI without examining specific obligations or exemptions.
cases.evidence: Determine applicable roles, funding/system thresholds, issuance-based deadline and authorized exemption; no blanket legal conclusion.

limitations: Existing risk hypotheses reused; no new canonical or local risk IDs needed.

RPY-03 objective 1 qualifies plaintext logging by necessity, whereas VER-03 objective 1 prohibits plaintext logging at any point. Preserve actor-specific wording and seek clarification of RP necessity boundary.
RPY-08 permissive acceptance must be examined alongside specific government/health-provider obligations, not treated as universal exemption.
No actual deployment evidence, legal conclusion, risk scoring or verified guardrails.
